records.title: Fractions — teacher module
records.adopted: Compare a fixed unit whole and the divisor-sized measure; explain a fractional quotient rather than counting only full containers.
records.rejected: Do not interpret a fractional quotient as a fractional number of completely full cups.

records.limitations: Foreign teacher guidance; no OPH or efficacy claim.

planning.childGoal: Ymmärrän, montako jakajan kokoista määrää jaettava sisältää.
planning.assumptions: Only frozen required prerequisite groups; no added hard gates. Context units explained locally.
planning.scope: Fraction division by nonzero fractions including noninteger quotients.
planning.evidenceLimits: Support/feedback allowed; no formal independent mastery or personal history. Human target-learner review pending.
planning.sourceVsDesign: Canonical objective/provenance inherited; sources corroborate mathematical/conceptual facts. Examples, controls and story are project design.
planning.assetProvenance: Supplied actual transparent Aava PNG unchanged; mathematical SVG generated from own deterministic model.

extensions.executionLimits: Finite declared scenes phase0..2; unsupported enums fail explicitly; all arithmetic exact integers/rationals, no eval or runtime network. Independent signed rational domain bounded absnumerator1000 and denominators1..1000 for division; positive ratio domain0..1000 denominators1..1000. Parser copied established self-contained exact contract: raw128 limit, normalized decimal4+3 significant places; equivalent unreduced fractions accepted. No unsupported input silently defaults. Optional model step/play1100ms for disclosure only, not physical simulation time. Sibling-root/per-root owner lifecycle; current selectors reread on action/input/change; dispose cleans listeners/timers. Initial staticSVG same state as live reset. Answer uses text keyboard request so slash is available in ordinary mobile text input; exact formats still checked, actual OS keyboard manually unverified.
